profile.headline: Software Engineer at Skymantics
profile.summary: I'm a seasoned software engineer with over 10 years of experience crafting innovative and user-friendly applications. My expertise lies in Java for back-end development and JavaScript for front-end, where I've embraced popular frameworks to create seamless user experiences. I'm driven by a passion for problem-solving and a knack for delivering robust, scalable solutions

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:

Containerizing applications and providing infrastructure as code to different types of users.

Developing a web based interface in Angular to provide infrastructure configuration to users.
